664e48e9-443c-4d1b-840b-e43cfbfbfc9d/Eve.cn: 这一日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>来到抚育<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的蛟池……<NL><NL>{0}

c7d5d103-9ad3-4a62-93d2-b5e387ca7c5d/Eve.en: Seeing <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> with eyes closed and tail drooping, coiled on the rocks,<NL>hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s footsteps approaching, it slightly opened its eyes,<NL> and under the warm sun, lazily turned its body, looking utterly bored...
c7d5d103-9ad3-4a62-93d2-b5e387ca7c5d/Eve.cn: 只见<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>阖目垂尾，盘踞于山石之上，<NL> 听得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>脚步声响近，便又微张双眼， <NL>在暖阳照映之下，慵懒地转动着身子，一副百无聊赖之态……

c7d5d103-9ad3-4a62-93d2-b5e387ca7c5d/Opt.en: (A Jiao is no ordinary beast; it also understands human feelings, and will naturally have its dull and boring moments...)
c7d5d103-9ad3-4a62-93d2-b5e387ca7c5d/Opt.cn: （蛟非凡兽，亦通人情，自有枯燥无味之时……）
c7d5d103-9ad3-4a62-93d2-b5e387ca7c5d/Opt.ru: (Цзяо - не обычный зверь; он также понимает человеческие чувства, и, естественно, у него будут свои скучные моменты...)

a3be4671-b46e-48f3-bf83-efedf40ea1c9/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has other important matters and pays no attention to <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>,<NL>turns around and leaves the Jiao Pool...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> amuses itself, <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>
a3be4671-b46e-48f3-bf83-efedf40ea1c9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>另有要事，无意理会<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>，<NL>转身离开了蛟池……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>自行自乐，<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

4b288a1f-0b43-4360-b2f8-e28e67873478/Eve.en: According to the Loong Keeper siblings: Whenever a Jiao is bored,<NL>one can lead a school of fish to play with it, to activate its muscles; <NL>or make a Jiao-shaped boat for competitive racing, to quicken its speed; <NL>or take "Loong and Phoenix" to fight with it, to strengthen its courage...
4b288a1f-0b43-4360-b2f8-e28e67873478/Eve.cn: 据豢龙氏兄妹所言：凡遇长蛟烦闷之时，<NL>可引群鱼与之相戏，以活其筋肉；<NL>或可制蛟形小舟，相逐竞渡，以迅其速度；<NL>又或取“龙凤”与之相博，以壮其勇力……

10f0e7fb-e12d-4c7c-ae62-27ddff3dc9bd/Eve.en: Raising a Jiao is like raising a child.<NL>Those who wish it to become a loong: accelerate its growth;<NL>Those who let nature take its course: treat it with equanimity;<NL>Those who discipline its cautious behavior: train it gently and rigorously;<NL>These three methods of raising each have strengths and weaknesses; each has clarity and obscurity.<NL>How to choose is entirely in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind...
10f0e7fb-e12d-4c7c-ae62-27ddff3dc9bd/Eve.cn: 养蛟如育儿，<NL>望其成龙者，急进助长；<NL>顺其自然者，平心相待；<NL>律其慎行者，恂恂驯养；<NL>此三者养育之法，有所长，亦有所短；有所明，亦有所蔽。<NL>如何抉择，全在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一念之间……

f6318cf7-24bd-4099-989c-b82c71700f1f/Eve.en: Water striking rocks makes them ring; people spurred on achieve great ambition...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> observes that <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> has been gentle and submissive recently,<NL>if raised with the method of accelerating growth, <color=#orange>it may produce unexpected results</color>...
f6318cf7-24bd-4099-989c-b82c71700f1f/Eve.cn: 水激石则鸣，人激志则宏……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>观<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>近日平易逊顺，<NL>若以急进助长之法养育，<color=#orange>或将有出人意表之效</color>……

ebd97172-e2f5-4ed6-835e-f65711a20768/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment,<NL>commanded the villagers to bring a hundred swimming carp and release them into the Jiao Pool.<NL>As the fish entered the pool, they immediately gathered around <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>, some chasing its tail in play, some swimming around the rocks.<NL>Sure enough, this led <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> to wag its tail and soar, riding the waves into the air...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>
ebd97172-e2f5-4ed6-835e-f65711a20768/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，<NL>令村民取来百尾游鲤，放入蛟池之中，<NL>群鱼入池，立时聚于<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>四周，或逐蛟尾嬉戏，或绕山石游弋，<NL>果然引得<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>摆尾腾骧，乘浪凌空……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

037ac24e-37d0-49db-96d7-03264cf97745/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment,<NL>commanded the villagers to gather materials and make a loong boat, placing it in the Jiao Pool,<NL>then summoned dozens of people to ride the Jiao boat together, taking turns at the oars, breaking the waves and racing,<NL>and sure enough, this led <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> to leap into the water, chasing and racing, playing like this for a long time...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！)</color>
037ac24e-37d0-49db-96d7-03264cf97745/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，<NL>令村民取材制作龙舟，置于蛟池之中，<NL>又唤来数十人共乘蛟舟，轮转橹棹，破浪而驰，<NL>果然引得<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>跃入水间，相逐竞渡，如是嬉玩许久……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

6e166020-a109-42b3-b2d0-ed4df7112ea2/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment,<NL>commanded the villagers to bring a hundred long snakes and golden pheasants, placing them around the Jiao Pool,<NL>and sure enough, this led <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> to soar into the air, tussling and fighting with the "loong and phoenix",<NL>before long, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> had captured the "loong and phoenix" alive...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！)</color>
6e166020-a109-42b3-b2d0-ed4df7112ea2/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，<NL>令村民取来百只长蛇、锦鸡，置于蛟池四周，<NL>果然引得<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>腾空而起，与“龙凤”扭打缠斗于一处，<NL>不过多时，便见<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>将“龙凤”生擒活捉……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

ba5d2b0c-94d7-4bf6-8497-12e0c688f55d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment, summoned dozens of villagers,<NL>commanded them to hold gongs or set up drums, lining up in a row along the shore of the Jiao Pool,<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gave the order, everyone raised gongs and beat drums, making a loud rumbling,<NL>After a short while, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> suddenly soared gracefully into the clouds, stirring up vast winds; swept back the pool water, spewing torrential rain...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！)</color>
ba5d2b0c-94d7-4bf6-8497-12e0c688f55d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，唤来数十名村民，<NL>令其或持锣、或架鼓，于蛟池岸边一字排开，<NL>随着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一声令下，众人扬锣捣鼓，隆隆作响，<NL>如是片刻过后，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>忽而夭矫入云，荡起浩浩风；倒卷池水，吐出滂沱雨……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

d817a38a-f7ab-481f-aa60-4f0c976a3c51/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment, fetched brush, ink, paper, and inkstone,<NL>before <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s eyes, drew pavilions, flowers and birds... all kinds of worldly things,<NL>After a short while, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> indeed exhaled and formed a mirage, above the several-hectare Jiao Pool,<NL>sometimes appearing jade palaces and crystal towers, mermaid maidens and loong maidens coming and going; sometimes emerald skies and thousand mountains, birds and beasts nestled together...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！)</color>
d817a38a-f7ab-481f-aa60-4f0c976a3c51/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，取来笔墨纸砚，<NL>于<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>眼前绘制楼阁、花鸟……种种世间万物，<NL>如是片刻过后，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>果然吐气结蜃，数顷蛟池之上，<NL>时而见琼楼玉宇，鲛姝龙女往来；时而见碧落千山，飞禽走兽相依……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

19e43ac6-c423-4f4e-a93c-741410a969a2/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment,<NL>commanded the villagers to bring many metals, stones, pearls, and jade, piling them up in the Jiao Pool,<NL>and sure enough, this led <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s eyes to light up, diving into the pile of metals, stones, and jade,<NL>sometimes adorning its head with gold, sometimes holding jade in its mouth to adorn its tail...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！)</color>
19e43ac6-c423-4f4e-a93c-741410a969a2/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，<NL>令村民取来诸多金石、珠玉，堆陈于蛟池中，<NL>果然引得<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>双目一亮，飞扑至金石玉堆之中，<NL>或取金饰首，或衔玉缀尾……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

60ed30ac-89ee-478b-a40e-9be073aa87e6/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment, commanded the villagers to bring several bolts of colored silk,<NL>and with several poles of bamboo, hung the colored silk on the tips, erecting them by the side of the Jiao Pool,<NL>on the silk were embroidered cloud patterns or adorned with tassels... in a moment, the wind rose, and the silks fluttered,<NL>and sure enough, this led <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> to wag its tail and swim close, biting the silk and playing...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！)</color>
60ed30ac-89ee-478b-a40e-9be073aa87e6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，令村民取来数匹彩帛，<NL>又以数竿青竹，悬彩帛于梢头，竖于蛟池之畔，<NL>帛上或绣云纹，或缀流苏……须臾风起，霎时绫罗飘展，<NL>果然引得<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>摆尾游近，衔帛戏耍……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

8fbff307-e774-4c46-a1b3-02c90c33953d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> summoned a hundred skilled singers and dancers,<NL>lined them up along the shore of the Jiao Pool, Tier bamboo and tune strings, singing and dancing, a lively scene,<NL><JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> seemed moved by the music, gradually emerging from the water, swaying its tail to the beat of the drums...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>
8fbff307-e774-4c46-a1b3-02c90c33953d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>召来百名能歌善舞者，<NL>于蛟池岸边一字排开，品竹调弦，载歌载舞，好不热闹，<NL><JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>似乎亦为乐声打动，渐渐冒出水面，随着鼓点摇晃起尾巴……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

e04f93d4-dd99-4ea6-9858-0e22532aa8ec/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sat by the Jiao Pool, pouring out his heart to <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>,<NL>after a while, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> raised its head and looked back,<NL>swaying slightly toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, as if adding some Get Closer and tacit understanding...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>
e04f93d4-dd99-4ea6-9858-0e22532aa8ec/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>坐于蛟池之畔，与<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>吐露衷肠，<NL>半晌过后，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>便昂起脑袋，回望过来，<NL>朝着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>微微摆动，仿佛添了几分亲近与默契……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

d52deaf5-2711-48d5-becf-fa17181ce34a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> took Foodstuff to feed <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>,<NL>finally restoring it to Normal...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>
d52deaf5-2711-48d5-becf-fa17181ce34a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>取来食材投喂<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>，<NL>终于令其恢复如常……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

88d21152-df46-40dd-956f-1823ee7fa782/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> paid no attention and turned to leave the Jiao Pool...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>

477ecb3e-53a6-41e6-b53f-84930fbf844d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment, summoned dozens of villagers,<NL>commanded them to hold gongs or set up drums, lining up in a row along the shore of the Jiao Pool,<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gave the order, everyone raised gongs and beat drums, making a loud rumbling,<NL>After a short while, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> suddenly soared gracefully into the clouds, stirring up vast winds; swept back the pool water, spewing torrential rain...<NL><NL>But <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> seemed to be startled by the gongs and drums, and before long, actually dived to the bottom of the pool...
477ecb3e-53a6-41e6-b53f-84930fbf844d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，唤来数十名村民，<NL>令其或持锣、或架鼓，于蛟池岸边一字排开，<NL>随着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一声令下，众人扬锣捣鼓，隆隆作响，<NL>如是片刻过后，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>忽而夭矫入云，荡起浩浩风；倒卷池水，吐出滂沱雨……<NL><NL>只是<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>似乎为锣鼓所惊，不过多时，竟潜于池底……

b22bcce5-c131-491f-986c-4b0d2f2b48b7/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>坐于蛟池之畔，<NL>与<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>讲述了一些关于神龙的轶闻趣事，<NL>终于令其渐渐冒出水面，恢复如常……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

2cf2fc3b-09b4-4dc2-9fcf-0c192d17e613/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment, took Brush and Ink, paper and inkstone,<NL>drew pavilions, flowers and birds... all kinds of things in the world before <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s eyes,<NL>after a short while, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> indeed exhaled mist to form a mirage, over several acres of the Jiao Pool,<NL>sometimes seeing vermilion towers towering among emerald, mermaids and loong maidens coming and going; sometimes seeing vast blue skies and thousands of mountains, birds and beasts relying on each other...<NL><NL>But while exhaling mist to form the mirage, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> seemed to accidentally cause damage to its Primordial Qi...
2cf2fc3b-09b4-4dc2-9fcf-0c192d17e613/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，取来笔墨纸砚，<NL>于<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>眼前绘制楼阁、花鸟……种种世间万物，<NL>如是片刻过后，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>果然吐气结蜃，数顷蛟池之上，<NL>时而见丹楼耸翠，鲛姝龙女往来；时而见碧落千山，飞禽走兽相依……<NL><NL>只是<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>吐气结蜃之时，似乎意外导致元气受损……

da19e7fe-e628-4d26-91e8-2e98c192e221/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> took Jade, placed it around <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>,<NL>finally restoring it to Normal...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>
da19e7fe-e628-4d26-91e8-2e98c192e221/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>取来玉石，放置于<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>周身，<NL>终于令其恢复如常……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

a07d16ab-fb40-4b97-82bc-5e12d77c558e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment,<NL>commanded the villagers to bring many gold, stone, pearls and jade, piling them in the Jiao Pool,<NL>and sure enough, this led <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s eyes to light up, and it flew into the pile of gold, stone and jade,<NL>either taking gold to adorn its head, or biting jade to hang on its tail...<NL><NL>But a moment later, <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/> suddenly panted heavily,<NL>as if carrying a thousand jun Weight, unable to continue...
a07d16ab-fb40-4b97-82bc-5e12d77c558e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，<NL>令村民取来诸多金石、珠玉，堆陈于蛟池中，<NL>果然引得<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>双目一亮，飞扑至金石玉堆之中，<NL>或取金饰首，或衔玉缀尾……<NL><NL>只是片刻过后，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>忽然气喘吁吁，<NL>似是负重千钧，难以为继……

7f64ad80-3991-429f-a3ee-261280d94f80/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> removed the gold and jade from <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>,<NL>and replaced them with lighter Silver to decorate <JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>, finally restoring it to Normal...<NL><NL><color=#yellow>(<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>'s <ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>!)</color>
7f64ad80-3991-429f-a3ee-261280d94f80/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>取下<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>周身金玉，<NL>又以较为轻便的银钱替<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>装饰，终于令其恢复如常……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

7c907edb-d53b-4986-b081-847e6e4e5f78/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思索片刻，令村民取来数匹彩帛，<NL>又以数竿青竹，悬彩帛于梢头，竖于蛟池之畔，<NL>帛上或绣云纹，或缀流苏……须臾风起，霎时绫罗飘展，<NL>果然引得<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>摆尾游近，衔帛戏耍……<NL><NL>只是片刻过后，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>>不慎力重，<NL>那彩帛竟被撕作数片，纷纷落入池中……

1807880e-0130-42e8-b2b1-14545b29f3cb/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>另取质地坚韧的麻布，<NL>悬于竹梢，令<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>戏耍摆弄，<NL>如此片刻，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>终于恢复如常……<NL><NL><color=#yellow>（<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>的<ArgBox key=JiaoPropertyDesc type=string/>！）</color>

925de5d1-0544-45fe-a2b1-967ff84cf093/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>召来百名能歌善舞者，<NL>于蛟池岸边一字排开，品竹调弦，载歌载舞，好不热闹，<NL><JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>似乎亦为乐声打动，渐渐冒出水面，随着鼓点摇晃起尾巴……<NL><NL>只是片刻过后，<JiaoLoong key=MonthlyEvent_arg1 str=JiaoLoongName/>似觉乐声搅扰，<NL>忽然摆尾腾空，张露獠牙，惊散众人……

0f7d66ec-a113-4b18-8723-39b08d71996d/Eve.cn: 养蛟如育儿，<NL>望其成龙者，急进助长；<NL>顺其自然者，平心相待；<NL>律其慎行者，恂恂驯养；<NL>此三者养育之法，有所长，亦有所短；有所明，亦有所蔽。<NL>如何抉择，全在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一念之间……
